sentences.text: Eoptolamna was a cartilaginous fish belonging to the class Chondrichthyes.
This animal is classified within the family Eoptolamnidae.
The genus Eoptolamna was described by Kriwet, Klug, Canudo, and Cuenca-Bescos in 2008.
The type species of the genus Eoptolamna is the extinct species Eoptolamna eccentrolopha.
A second valid species, Eoptolamna supracretacea, was described by Guinot, Underwood, Cappetta, and Ward in 2013.
The species lived from the Barremian to the Campanian stages, between 125.77 and 72.2 million years ago.
Fossils of Eoptolamna have been found in Europe and North Africa.
